model: RandomForestClassifier (sklearn, n_estimators=300, random_state=42) on all 8 raw features
notes: Dropped 57 exact duplicate rows before an 80/20 stratified split (random_state=42). Zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi were kept as-is, since trees handle them and they are consistent codes; 5-fold CV on train gave ~0.82, so the 173-row test estimate is noisy.
